He is a graduate of SPIRE Institute and Academy, an [[United States Olympic Training Center|Olympic training center]] in [[Geneva, Ohio]]. ==High school career== Pickett played high school basketball for the [[Aquinas Institute]] in [[Rochester, New York]]. In his junior season, he led his team to a [[New York State Public High School Athletic Association]] (NYSPHSAA) Class AA championship while earning [[most valuable player]] (MVP) honors. As a senior, Pickett averaged 20 points and 10 rebounds per game, reaching the Class AA Federation Final.{{cite web|first=Zachary|last=Memmott|title=Aquinas graduate Jalen Pickett takes his game to next level at Siena College|url=https://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/sports/2019/03/08/jalen-pickett-siena-college-basketball-maac-rookie-of-the-year-nba-aquinas-institute/3088179002/|work=[[Democrat and Chronicle]]|date=March 8, 2019|access-date=December 17, 2019}}{{cite web|first=Mark|last=Singelais|title=Jalen Pickett couldn't wait to join Siena basketball|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Jalen-Pickett-couldn-t-wait-to-join-Siena-12907517.php|work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]]|date=May 11, 2018|access-date=December 17, 2019}} He played for the [[Albany, New York|Albany]]-based program City Rocks on the [[Amateur Athletic Union]] (AAU) circuit and was teammates with five-star recruit [[Isaiah Stewart]].{{cite web|first=Mark|last=Singelais|title=Siena basketball's Jalen Pickett feels at home in TU Center|url=https://www.thehour.com/sports/article/Siena-men-s-basketball-13327943.php |website=[[The Hour (newspaper)|The Hour]]|date=October 22, 2018|access-date=December 17, 2019}} Playing for the City Rocks, Pickett led the [[Nike Elite Youth Basketball League]] in [[player efficiency rating|player efficiency]].{{cite web|first=Mark|last=Singelais|title=Siena basketball's Jalen Pickett overlooked no longer|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Siena-basketball-s-Jalen-Pickett-overlooked-no-13556919.php|work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]]|date=January 27, 2019|access-date=December 17, 2019}} For academic reasons, he completed a [[postgraduate year]], during which he played for SPIRE Institute in [[Geneva, Ohio]]. Pickett averaged 14 points, 6.3 rebounds, 4.6 assists and 2.1 steals per game. He became academically eligible to play in the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association]] (NCAA). Pickett was considered a three-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[Rivals.com|Rivals]] and received few offers from [[NCAA Division I]] programs. He committed to [[Siena Saints men's basketball|Siena]] to play for first-year head coach [[Jamion Christian]].{{cite web|first=Michael|last=Kelly|title=How Siena College men's basketball landed Jalen Pickett|url=https://dailygazette.com/article/2019/03/07/how-siena-college-men-s-basketball-landed-jalen-pickett|work=[[The Daily Gazette]]|date=March 7, 2019|access-date=December 17, 2019}} ==College career== [[File:Jalen Pickett.jpg|thumb|left|Jalen Pickett with the [[Siena Saints men's basketball|Siena Saints]] in 2019|320x320px]] On February 17, 2019, Pickett, in his first year at Siena, had a career-high 46 points and 13 assists in a 107–100 triple-overtime loss to [[2018–19 Quinnipiac Bobcats men's basketball team|Quinnipiac]].{{cite news|title=Young scores 55 in Quinnipiac's 107–100 3OT win over Siena|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401085775|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=February 17, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}} He was named [[Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference]] (MAAC) Rookie of the Week 11 times, a league record.{{cite news|first=Mark|last=Singelais|title=Siena basketball's Jalen Pickett sets sights on MAAC title|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Pickett-looking-for-big-year-14539977.php|work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]]|date=October 16, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}} As a freshman, Pickett averaged 15.8 points, 4.6 rebounds, 2.1 steals and 6.7 assists per game, which ranked ninth nationally.{{cite news|title=Siena guard Jalen Pickett pulls out of NBA draft|url=https://wtop.com/ncaa-basketball/2019/05/siena-guard-jalen-pickett-pulls-out-of-nba-draft/|work=WTOP|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=May 29, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019|archive-date=December 23, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191223201637/https://wtop.com/ncaa-basketball/2019/05/siena-guard-jalen-pickett-pulls-out-of-nba-draft/|url-status=dead}} Pickett was named First-team All-MAAC and MAAC Rookie of the Year. After the season he declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]] and participated in the [[G League Elite Camp]] but ultimately decided to return to Siena.{{cite news|first=Mark|last=Singelais|title=Siena's Jalen Pickett withdrawing from NBA draft|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Siena-s-Jalen-Pickett-withdrawing-from-NBA-draft-13904449.php|work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]]|date=May 29, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}} Pickett missed a game against [[2019–20 Colgate Raiders men's basketball team|Colgate]] on November 30, 2019, for a violation of team rules.{{cite news|first=Eric|last=Fishbin|title=Siena men's basketball loses to Colgate as Pickett sits|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Siena-men-s-basketball-loses-to-Colgate-as-14873110.php|work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]]|date=November 30, 2019|access-date=December 23, 2019}} On February 14, 2020, he scored a season-high 27 points in a 73–64 win over [[2019–20 Rider Broncs men's basketball team|Rider]].{{cite news|title=Pickett scores 27 to lift Siena past Rider 73–64|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401172078|work=[[ESPN]]|agency=[[Associated Press]]|date=February 14, 2020|access-date=April 3, 2020}} At the close of the 2019–20 regular season, Pickett was named the [[Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|MAAC Player of the Year]].{{cite press release|title=Siena's Jalen Pickett Named Player of the Year, Saint Peter's Sweeps Remaining Major Awards|url=https://maacsports.com/news/2020/3/11/mens-basketball-sienas-jalen-pickett-named-player-of-the-year-saint-peters-sweeps-remaining-major-awards.aspx|website=MAACSports.com|publisher=[[Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference]]|date=March 11, 2020|access-date=March 11, 2020}} He helped the team win the MAAC regular-season championship, averaging 15.1 points and a league-leading 6 assists per game while shooting 37.4 percent from three-point range.{{cite news|first=Mark|last=Singelais|title=Siena's Jalen Pickett undecided on testing NBA draft waters again|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Siena-s-Jalen-Pickett-undecided-on-testing-draft-15144695.php|work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]]|date=March 19, 2020|access-date=April 3, 2020}} As a junior, Pickett was limited by a hamstring injury and multiple [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19]] pauses, averaging 12.9 points, 6.3 rebounds and 4.8 assists per game.{{cite web|first=Jeff|last=Borzello|title=Penn State Nittany Lions land point guard transfer Jalen Pickett|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/31332969|work=[[ESPN]]|date=April 25, 2021|access-date=April 26, 2021}} He earned First Team All-MAAC honors for his third consecutive season.{{cite web|first=Mark|last=Singelais|title=Siena basketball's Manny Camper, Jalen Pickett named to all-MAAC first team|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/Siena-basketball-s-Manny-Camper-Jalen-Pickett-16008641.php|work=[[Times Union (Albany)|Times Union]]|date=March 8, 2021|access-date=April 26, 2021}} On April 25, 2021, Pickett announced that he would transfer to [[Penn State Nittany Lions basketball|Penn State]], choosing the Nittany Lions over [[Oregon State Beavers men's basketball|Oregon State]]. He averaged 13.3 points, 4.3 rebounds, 4.4 assists and 1.1 steals per game. Pickett announced he would return for his final season of eligibility.{{cite web|title=Gotta Run It Back: Jalen Pickett To Return For His Final Season|url=https://www.blackshoediaries.com/2022/3/12/22974315/penn-state-basketball-guard-jalen-pickett-return-final-season-nittany-lions-micah-shrewsberry|website=BlackShoeDiaries.com|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=March 12, 2022|access-date=March 2, 2023}} On February 14, 2023, Pickett scored a career-high 41 points in a 93–81 victory over [[2022–23 Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball team|Illinois]], becoming Penn State's first 40-point scorer since 1961 and setting a [[Bryce Jordan Center]] record.{{cite web|first=Mark|last=Wogenrich|title=Jalen Pickett Leads Penn State Out of the Wilderness|url=https://www.msn.com/en-us/sports/other/jalen-pickett-leads-penn-state-out-of-the-wilderness/ar-AA17uGdJ|website=MSN.com|date=February 2023|access-date=November 17, 2023}} He also became the fourth Penn State player to score 2,000 points.{{cite web|first=Spencer|last=Ripchik|title=Penn State men's basketball guard Jalen Pickett scores his 2,000th career point against Illinois|url=https://www.collegian.psu.edu/sports/men_basketball/penn-state-mens-basketball-guard-jalen-pickett-scores-his-2-000th-career-point-against-illinois/article_6d40e074-acca-11ed-bd8e-434a2d88e9b5.html|work=[[Daily Collegian]]|date=February 14, 2023|access-date=March 2, 2023}} Pickett followed up his historic performance with a 32-point performance against [[2022–23 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]] on February 18, 2023.{{cite web | last=Gallen | first=Daniel | title=Jalen Pickett continues star turn in another Penn State win: 'He's putting us on his back' | website=247Sports | date=2023-02-19 | url=https://247sports.com/college/penn-state/article/jalen-pickett-continues-star-turn-in-another-penn-state-win-hes--204992017/ | access-date=2025-12-08}} His combined two-game totals of 73 points, 16 assists and 11 rebounds earned him multiple national player-of-the-week honors. The two-game stat line was also only the third time over the last 25 seasons in NCAA Division I basketball or the NBA where a player scored 70-plus points, had 15-plus assists and 10-plus rebounds with a 65% field goal accuracy and 90% free-throw rate. The other two players to accomplish this feat were [[LeBron James]] (2017) and [[Stephen Curry]] (2022).{{cite web|first=Mark|last=Wogenrich|title=Can Jalen Pickett Will Penn State to the NCAA Tournament?|url=https://www.si.com/college/pennstate/basketball/penn-state-basketball-is-jalen-pickett-the-nations-best-point-guard|website=SI.com|date=February 19, 2023|access-date=November 17, 2023}} ==Professional career== The [[Indiana Pacers]] selected Pickett with the 32nd overall pick in the [[2023 NBA draft]] and subsequently traded his draft rights to the [[Denver Nuggets]].{{cite news|title=THE DENVER NUGGETS ACQUIRE THE DRAFT RIGHTS TO JULIAN STRAWTHER, JALEN PICKETT AND HUNTER TYSON IN DRAFT NIGHT TRADE|url=https://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/the-denver-nuggets-acquire-the-draft-rights-to-julian-strawther-jalen-pickett-and-hunter-tyson-in-draft-night-trade|website=NBA.com|date=June 23, 2023|access-date=June 23, 2023}} With the selection, Pickett became the highest-drafted former Siena Saint,{{cite news|first=Mark|last=Singlelais|title=Former Siena guard Jalen Pickett headed to Nuggets with 32nd pick|url=https://www.timesunion.com/sports/article/former-siena-guard-jalen-pickett-headed-nuggets-18166706.php |work=Times Union|date=June 23, 2023|access-date=June 23, 2023}} and he and [[Seth Lundy]] were the first pair of Penn State Nittany Lions teammates to be selected in the same NBA draft.{{cite news|first=Jerry|last=DiPaola|title=Penn State pair Jalen Pickett, Seth Lundy picked in 2nd round of NBA Draft by Nuggets, Hawks|url=https://triblive.com/sports/penn-state-pair-jalen-pickett-seth-lundy-picked-in-2nd-round-of-nba-draft-by-nuggets-hawks/|work=Pittsburgh Tribune Review|date=June 23, 2023|access-date=June 23, 2023}}{{cite news|first=Matt|last=Hymowitz|title=Jalen Pickett, Seth Lundy chosen in NBA Draft in historic night for Penn State basketball|url=https://www.centredaily.com/sports/college/penn-state-university/psu-basketball/article276634101.html|work=Centre Daily Times|date=June 23, 2023|access-date=June 23, 2023}} On July 6, 2023, the Denver Nuggets announced that they had signed with Pickett.{{cite web|title=Nuggets sign Julian Strawther, Jalen Pickett, and Hunter Tyson|url=https://www.nba.com/nuggets/news/nuggets-sign-julian-strawther-jalen-pickett-and-hunter-tyson|date=July 6, 2023|website=NBA.com|access-date=July 6, 2023}} On April 2, 2025, Pickett recorded his first career [[triple-double]], with 17 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in a 113–106 loss against the [[2024–25 San Antonio Spurs season|San Antonio Spurs]] in his second career start.{{Cite web |last=Horstman |first=Will |date=2025-04-02 |title=SEE IT: Former Penn State guard Jalen Pickett records first NBA career triple-double |url=https://www.psucollegian.com/sports/men_basketball/see-it-former-penn-state-guard-jalen-pickett-records-first-nba-career-triple-double/article_f2883810-b8d1-41b6-9f41-da6919c10eb0.html |access-date=2025-04-03 |website=The Daily Collegian |language=en}} On January 5, 2026, Pickett recorded a career-high 29 points on a career-high seven three-pointers made, along with five rebounds and seven assists in a 125–124 overtime win over the [[2025–26 Philadelphia 76ers season|Philadelphia 76ers]].{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/denver-nuggets/nuggets-news-jalen-picketts-reaction-to-career-night-vs-76ers-cant-be-topped|title=Nuggets guard Jalen Pickett's reaction to career night vs. 76ers can't be topped|website=ClutchPoints|last=Pagaduan|first=Jedd|date=January 5, 2026|access-date=January 5, 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/sixers-nuggets-score-jalen-pickett/?ftag=CNM-00-10aag7e|title=Philadelphia 76ers lose to short-handed Denver Nuggets in OT as Maxey misses floater in final seconds|website=CBS News|date=January 5, 2026|access-date=January 5, 2026}} In June 2026, the Nuggets declined Pickett's fourth-year option for the 2026-27 season, making him a free agent.{{cite news |last1=Durando |first1=Bennett |title=Nuggets decline Jalen Pickett’s team option for 2026-27 season, sources say |url=https://www.denverpost.com/2026/06/29/nuggets-decline-jalen-pickett-team-option-nba-free-agency/ |access-date=July 7, 2026 |work=[[The Denver Post]] |date=June 29, 2026}} ==Career statistics==
